title: Class
description: A hero class: the kit, the weapons and armor, the three schools and the ultimate (03-GAME-DESIGN §2.3, §6.1, §7.1). One file per class under content/classes/<id>.json. The 45 skills themselves live in content/skills/ and point back here by classId.

role.description: One line on what the class does in a party, shown on its creation card (e.g. 'front-line tank').

attributeMods.description: Added to 10 + species mods at creation (§2.3). The linter checks the sum is +4.

pool.description: The class family's resource pool (§3.2): stamina for physical classes, mana for casters.

weaponTypes.description: Weapon and off-hand types the class may equip (§6.3).

schools.description: Exactly three schools, each a way of playing the class (§7.1). Skills reference a school by its id.

philosophy.description: One or two sentences on what the school is for.

ultimateSkillId.description: The class's one Ultimate, a Tier III skill with isUltimate true (§7.1).

starterKit.description: Item ids of the F-grade starter gear in the class's armor family (§2.3).

starterSkillIds.description: The three Tier I skills picked at creation (§7.2).

fieldSkillAffinities.description: Field skills the class is good at (§7.6: Shade → Lockpicking, Ranger → Trap Disarm, Mender → First Aid). The bonus is added to the field skill's rank for checks.

monsterTechniqueIds.description: Skill ids of this class's monster techniques — Tier III–IV skills that only Insight while that monster uses the move (§7.5).

aiRuleDefault.description: The gambit line a new hero of this class starts with (§3.6), e.g. 'IF ally HP < 40% THEN skill 2 on lowest ally; ELSE basic attack nearest'.

gearSetId.description: The starter gear set's visual id in the art pipeline.

palette.description: Class accent colours used on trims and effects.

notes.description: Art direction for the class silhouette.

pros.description: One-line strengths for the creation card (§13).

cons.description: One-line weaknesses for the creation card (§13).
